base: As for the two-dimensional result (Sec.~\ref{sec:uq-combine}, Ref.~\cite{AnalysisNote2026}, Table~\ref*{N-tab:pl-added}), the block $C_{\mathrm{PL,5D}}$ is built from these double ratios with no reference period: each group's offset from the exposure-weighted mean of the three, applied to the central value, with a reliability-weight factor for the weighted spread.
current: As for the two-dimensional result (Sec.~\ref{sec:uq-combine}, Ref.~\cite{AnalysisNote2026}, Table~\ref*{N-tab:pl-added}), the block $C_{\mathrm{PL,5D}}$ is built from these double ratios with no reference period.
With $e_X$ the exposure share of period group $X$, $r_X$ that group's unfolded result over its own simulated truth, and $m=\sum_X e_X r_X$, the fractional offset is $g_X=r_X/m-1$.
The reliability-weight factor is $k=V_2/(1-V_2)$, where $V_2=\sum_X e_X^2$.
The block is $k\sum_X e_X (x\circ g_X)(x\circ g_X)^{T}$, with $x$ the central value on these cells.
